recentItems.title: Denmark’s Conscription Is Changing |🇩🇰 From Civilian to Soldier
recentItems.description:
Denmark’s conscription system is changing. Watch Danish conscripts train to become soldiers during the Royal Life Guards’ demanding final field exercise.

Denmark is expanding its conscription system to include women, increasing the annual intake to 7,500 by 2033, and extending standard service from four to 11 months.

This film follows young men and women as they face physical and mental challenges, including field training, night movement, obstacle courses, ration preparation, and the final test known as REX-TUREN.

The transformation from civilian to soldier is part of a wider effort to strengthen Denmark’s national defence and NATO’s collective defence.

Learn more about Danish conscription, Forsvarets Dag, the Royal Life Guards, military training, and NATO readiness.

recentItems.title: NATO Allies united in supporting Ukraine 🇺🇦
recentItems.description:
Since Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, NATO Allies have provided unprecedented levels of support to Ukraine. From weapons and air defence systems to training, medical assistance and long-term recovery projects, NATO’s support continues to evolve across a broad range of areas.

Through initiatives such as PURL, NSATU, CAP and JATEC, NATO and Allied nations are helping coordinate military assistance, train Ukrainian personnel, support rehabilitation projects and apply lessons learned from the battlefield to future operations and strategy.

Ukraine’s defence against Russia’s aggression is reshaping modern warfare — from drone operations and innovation to interoperability and adaptation — with cooperation between NATO and Ukraine continuing to evolve in response to future security challenges.


More information about the NATO Summit 2026 in Ankara 🇹🇷: https://bit.ly/nato-ankara-summit
